Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly concluded that Jordan Pruitt is the co-writer of the song "Permission to Fly" based solely on her status as the "singer-songwriter" of the album. The WebSurfer search results explicitly stated that the song was written by Chen Neeman, Jeannie Lurie, and Aris Archontis, and did not list Jordan Pruitt as a writer. By ignoring the specific writing credits found in the search results and assuming the artist is a co-writer, the Planner failed to identify the correct "co-writer and recording artist" (which should have been one of the named writers if they performed, or identified that no such single entity existed for this specific track on this album) and consequently selected the wrong record label (Walt Disney Music Company instead of the correct Hollywood Records associated with the actual song/artist context implied by the ground truth). The Planner also prematurely concluded the task without verifying if any of the listed writers were also performers, leading to the wrong answer.
